note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase as reported by Push Square. Guides below are in our own words, built from the launch-day guides named in each trophy's sources. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch; those guides say so plainly instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals, so the road is long rather than hard: launch guides put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours, about 60 to 80 of them story. Work the roadmap in order, guard the one missable trophy in Chapter 1, and leave the 100% checklist for last.
steps: Follow the roadmap phases in order.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
Finish the story, then clear the side finales and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed. Play through the intro and it pops when the mission ends. Treat it as the start of the run: from here on, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because the game has no mission replay.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this pops, usually as the next chapter begins. Before you close the chapter out, do the one thing in the whole list that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, on a morning after the mission Down to Earth. It counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends, so do it now and keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.
steps: Play through Chapter 1.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is the chapter where the game opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia should become available here, and with it the partner trophies. Two apps that feed later trophies also unlock in this chapter, the Scooter Bros app through the mission Moses and the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver, so grab both when they appear.
steps: Play through Chapter 2.
When Moses unlocks the Scooter Bros app, register your first car.
When Daily Driver unlocks the Real Estate app, start buying garages.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. One race inside this chapter is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand, shows an hourglass icon and counts toward the Strangers & Freaks strand total. Save before you start it and race it the moment it appears rather than leaving it for later.
steps: Play through Chapter 3.
Race Against Yago as soon as it appears; save first.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The bank vault robberies unlock near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, so if you want the robbery trophies, take that mission before you move on to the finale. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, so nothing here is missable.
steps: Play through Chapter 4.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the second Gold on the list. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back if you want to replay the ending. After the credits, the side-story finales and the whole 100% checklist are still open.
steps: Keep a manual save from just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends, so just play the story in order and it comes to you.
steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Another unmissable story trophy: follow the story and it pops when the heist is done.
steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the story mission Child's Play to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the story mission Headliners to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends. The same airport is where the Catch Me If You Can jet trophy happens, so you will know the layout by then.
steps: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the last one most players will earn. The 100% checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls its thresholds lenient, roughly 60% of true completion, and the checklist runs to 35 tasks. Most of its progress comes from working on the other trophies first, so treat it as the cleanup phase, not a separate grind.
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work the other trophies; most checklist items fill along the way.
Clear the leftovers against the 100% table in this guide's Completion tab.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in total. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind. Keep going past 250, because 100% completion asks for 300.
steps: Attempt stunts as you travel; under-bridge flights are the fastest kind.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, gym training and bowling are the kinds the list points to. No confirmed full list of activity types exists at launch, so work through every activity icon you find on the map and check your progress after each new one.
steps: Try one of each activity you find: race, fish, arcade, shooting range, drone race, meditation, gym, bowling.
Check the trophy's progress after each new activity type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 gold medals across two shooting ranges. This is a skill check more than a grind, so learn each range's scoring, use the right weapon for each challenge, and replay the ones you miss until the golds are all in.
steps: Find both shooting ranges.
Replay each challenge until you hold gold in all 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 drone race locations. There are 42 races in total across those locations, but the trophy only needs one win per location, so learn each course's line and move on once you have won there.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at each.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: street races, off-road, boat and air races all feed it, as long as each race is one you have not won before. The 100% checklist asks for 30, so keep racing past 20 with new events rather than repeating the same one.
steps: Win races across different types and locations; each must be a new win.
Keep going to 30 different race wins for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens up early, and Cal's challenge is a head-to-head catch contest: match his catch, keep your line steady, and reel in cleanly. Take the challenge when it is offered rather than putting it off.
steps: Go fishing and take Cal's challenge when it appears.
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade in Vice City, pick a cabinet, and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you are best at and finish a full run.
steps: Find an arcade and pick a game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Side-story finales like this one stay open after the story ends, so there is no rush, but one guide warns that stranger mission chains can have windows tied to story progress, so start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks to be safe. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.
steps: Start Andy's stranger missions as soon as they unlock.
Play the strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Like the other side-story finales it stays open after the story, so finish it whenever you like, but begin the chain early: stranger strands are reported to have windows linked to story progress.
steps: Start Kenton's stranger missions as soon as they unlock.
Play the strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. It stays open after the story, but start the chain as soon as it unlocks. Billy's strand has its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Billy's stranger missions as soon as they unlock.
Play the strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because each has its own trophy, so do not waste time counting them. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to learn which ones counted. The Chapter 3 race against Yago is time-sensitive and belongs to a strand that counts, so race it the moment it appears.
steps: Play stranger strands across the state; skip counting Andy, Billy and Tyrone.
Check the progress counter after each finished strand.
Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Side-story finales stay open after the story, but begin the chain as soon as it unlocks, since stranger strands are reported to have windows tied to story progress.
steps: Start Randy's stranger missions as soon as they unlock.
Play the strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. It stays open after the story, but start the chain early. Tyrone's strand has its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Tyrone's stranger missions as soon as they unlock.
Play the strand through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations according to the launch guides, though the 100% checklist counts 15, so the two sources disagree and you should visit every spot you find. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The critical one is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, on a morning after the mission Down to Earth: it is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends, and whether the trophy strictly needs it is unconfirmed, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony in the morning and accept the meditation.
At every outdoor spot, meditate with both Jason and Lucia.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks, so work his strand when it opens and follow the deck it gives you. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Which animal the trophy wants is unconfirmed at launch, so follow Bret's strand rather than hunting at random.
steps: Start Bret's hunting strand (Jason only) and follow its target decks.
Take the unique animal with a clean head or heart shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. The cards are a collectible scattered across Leonida, and the 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so the trophy is an early milestone on a much longer hunt. Pick up every card you pass and track sets in the checklist, not from memory.
steps: Collect cards as you explore; complete any 3 sets for the trophy.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game way of logging places, and the count is the same 100 the 100% checklist asks for, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Scan or log locations as you travel instead of saving them for a dedicated sweep.
steps: Use the WAiNK app at new locations as you explore.
Reach 100 logged locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many of them complete on their own while you play the rest of the list. The 100% checklist asks for 70 of the 80, so keep an eye on the list during cleanup and pick off the ones that are closest to done.
steps: Open Progress, Challenges, and work the list as you play.
Reach 50 done, then 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest route is a bank vault job, which gives you 4 stars straight away: bring your partner, rob the vault, then break out of the red zone together. Launch guides also point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape.
steps: Call your partner in, then get to 4 stars (a bank vault job does it instantly).
Escape the red heat zone together; the trophy pops on leaving it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. Call your partner first, then hit three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment; if it still has not popped, one guide says to rob a fourth. North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together, which makes the run easier.
steps: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while still wanted.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop; rob a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so you do not need to drive them: scan traffic as you drive and the count climbs on its own. The 100% checklist asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning into the cleanup phase.
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive.
Reach 100 discovered, then 200 of 277 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Fill your Focus before you start, pick a group of gang enemies such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus. Cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count, so choose gang targets.
steps: Fill Combat Focus, then find a group of gang enemies.
Press L3 and R3 while aiming and take down 5 with an assault rifle.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the planes at gates E3 and E4 are reported to work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
steps: At VCIA, take a docked passenger jet at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a hint at the Rhino tank: get into a military tank. Tanks are reported to be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south side, far southwest island.
Get in a Rhino tank and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is reported to be a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Open a store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, clear the safe unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. A vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
steps: Take That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4.
Bring your partner, tail the van, rob the vault and escape; repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, take what it carries and break away from the police. It pairs naturally with the bank vault runs, since the same mission chain has you tailing security vans, so fold it into your robbery sessions rather than hunting trucks on their own.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and rob it.
Escape the police to finish the job.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog across the whole map. Flying over the dark patches is reported to be the quickest method, so take a plane or helicopter and sweep the unfogged areas in passes until the map is fully revealed.
steps: Fly over the dark, unexplored patches of the map.
Keep sweeping until no fog is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida, and the 100% checklist wants all 39 of them, so this trophy pops along the way while you work the full set. Track which gangs you have hit so none is left for last.
steps: Rob illegal operations across Leonida.
Make sure one belongs to each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists at launch: PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known, and its description is the only hint. The name and the Ocean Beach view point to a scenic bar or cocktail spot on the beachfront, so work the Ocean Beach bars and viewpoints when you are in the area. Do not trust any specific steps you read until a launch guide confirms them.
steps: Visit cocktail bars and viewpoints along Ocean Beach.
Order a drink where the view opens over the beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists at launch. One guide's best guess is crashing a car out through a showroom window, which fits the description's smash-your-way-out wording, but it is unconfirmed. Try driving a car through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side; if it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method rather than repeating the same guess.
steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom and drive out through the window.
If it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley, which is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so this one is not missable.
steps: Visit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 with Sticky Bombs.
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents, then escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: the launch guides report that this pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Work both characters' Strength up together rather than maxing one and starting the other.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train with your partner until both characters reach maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: one guide reports this needs 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, and robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind as you play the rest of the list. That figure comes from a single source, so treat it as reported rather than certain. One guide also warns that Irredeemable on the Criminal Profile is permanent, so read up on the profile before going on a rampage.
steps: Play normally; robberies and fights feed your Criminal Profile.
Check the profile after long sessions until it pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists at launch: PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known. The description, second time's the charm, hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is only a reading of the words. Do not chase a specific guess; keep it on the watch list and check the launch guides for a confirmed method.
steps: No confirmed steps at launch; watch the cited guides for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists at launch. One guide's guess is that it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, which fits the description, but it is unconfirmed. Treat this as a watch-list trophy: explore odd encounters as you find them and check the cited guides for a confirmed trigger.
steps: No confirmed steps at launch; watch the cited guides for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed steps exist at launch. The description, bowl them over with a melee drive-by, reads as knocking people down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, and the bowling name ties it to the Kingpin Bowling area, but neither part is confirmed. A cautious attempt is a melee-weapon drive-by near the bowling alley; if it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method.
steps: Try a melee-weapon drive-by near Kingpin Bowling.
If it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you launder them by selling them to your contacts and fences; the total is cumulative, so it grows across the whole game. One fence is reported to pay the most, and the total grows during the 100% robberies, so this trophy lands naturally if you work the robbery set.
steps: Take bank and payday loan jobs to collect Marked Bills.
Sell the bills to your contacts and fences until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it climbs on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, food and cars through the game. If it is the last one standing, top it up with big purchases rather than small ones.
steps: Spend across any shops; the $100,000 total is cumulative.
Top up with large purchases if it is nearly done.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and the four garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them as your money allows; they also give you the free spaces the Scooter Bros registrations need.
steps: Unlock the Real Estate app after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all 8 garages (about $160,000 in total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app through Moses in Chapter 2.
Respray and Register 10 cars; buy garages first so each has a space.
